sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tagilla is a Scav Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: People fear Tagilla far beyond the walls of Polikhim Plant #16. Some managed to flee the Factory after hearing his roar. But no one has ever survived his sledgehammer. Veterans still remember how Tagilla toyed with the PMC squads who dared to explore The Labyrinth beneath the health resort.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Tagilla has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 100; Thorax: 320; Stomach: 260; Arms: 130 each; Legs: 140 each; Total: 1220 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 triple slot pockets, bringing their total space to 15 slots.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Tagilla needs to be killed once each for the quests The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief and The Huntsman Path - Relentless.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Tagilla can be found on the following locations:

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: In the parking garage below the Goshan store.

sections.heading: Terminal
sections.text: In the medium container ship berths area. Note: Tagilla is only 1 of 5 possible bosses to spawn each raid.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: He is batshit insane and will attempt to hammer you down. However, if you are in a position that he cannot path-find to, such as the rafters, he will use his secondary weapon (usually a shotgun) to kill you from a distance. He's active immediately at the start of raid. The boss can set ambushes, open suppressive fire, and breach if needed.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
If you are using high penetrating ammunition, aim for his head, not his thorax. If you have low pen or high flesh damage, aim for his stomach since his armor only covers the thorax. The best plan of action is to bait out his swing so he's standing still, then shoot him. If you shoot while he's running at you, he'll just charge through it and absolutely murder you, so wait until he swings to shoot.

Tagillas welding masks do not protect his nape, therefore you can try to shoot him there. This strategy requires sneaking up behind him without you being detected, or a teammate that flanks him while he is fighting or chasing you.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Tagilla is the younger brother of Killa, the boss on the Interchange location.
- According to Jaeger in The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief, Tagilla is a former employee of the Chemical Plant No. 16, which is the Factory location.
- According to Jaeger in The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief, Tagilla's custom welding masks are inspired by Killa's custom Maska-1SCh helmet.
- Russia has the Tagil river and the city of Nizhny Tagil, which became famous thanks to the meme "Tagil rulit" in the Russian part of the internet. Briefly: The meme indicates indecent behavior while intoxicated.
  - Given this, and Tagilla's status as a worker at the Factory where TerraGroup was producing chemicals for drug research, it is possible that Tagilla's aggressive behavior and extreme physical toughness is caused by him being exposed to or otherwise under the influence of experimental drugs.
- Tagilla is voiced by Russian actor Ivan Zharkov. The same actor voices Thor in the Marvel films. Tagilla, like Thor, uses a hammer.
  - Interestingly, in November 2025, Ivan Zharkov wrote "Buyanov won" in his Telegram channel and posted a photo of his Steam library. Ivan had purchased EFT and started downloading the game. However, a few days later, he wrote "Refund" and explained that he had issued a refund for the Steam version of the game. He allegedly couldn't access the game. However, Ivan still had the game he had purchased on the official BSG website.
